'''May 2001 Vancouver tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hyperlight, Vancouver, BC on 20 May 2001. [[Kevin Staley]] won it. It is known from Cole Roche's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2355">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01d2355/ vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01], DeckTech (Cole "Rabid Wookie" Roche, 22 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01d2355/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Hyperlight, Vancouver, BC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Staley]]
